summary_md: **Findr ([@aifindr](https://x.com/aifindr/status/2116629214963052603))** lists 20 free repos forming a design studio for Claude, from Anthropic's frontend-design skill, UI UX Pro Max, Figma Context MCP and Magic MCP to Playwright MCP for screenshots and axe-core/Lighthouse audits ([anthropics/skills frontend-design](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design), [GLips/Figma-Context-MCP](https://github.com/GLips/Figma-Context-MCP), [microsoft/playwright-mcp](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp)).
